subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the core `read` tool fail fast for PDF/Office-like binary documents, route supported formats to existing document/PDF tooling, or grow parser-backed extraction in the read path?
rationale: Current main still decodes non-image bytes as text, but the safe fallback and parser-backed alternatives create different core ownership, security, and dependency obligations.

options.title: Narrow fallback guard
options.body: Return a clear structured message for known binary document formats in host and sandbox read paths, with regression tests for text/image passthrough and document blocking.

options.title: Parser-backed read
options.body: Add extraction for selected formats only after choosing archive/XML/parser dependencies, size limits, and security boundaries.

options.title: Route to separate tooling
options.body: Keep `read` text/image-only and make the model-facing description plus existing document/PDF tools handle supported formats explicitly.

recommendation.title: Narrow fallback guard
recommendation.body: Return a clear structured message for known binary document formats in host and sandbox read paths, with regression tests for text/image passthrough and document blocking.

likelyOwner.reason: Current read-tool and wrapper history points to this owner for deciding the agent-tool contract shape.
